icy.en: He was photographed riding horses shirtless, diving into icy waters, and piloting fighter jets.
icy.zh: 镜头记录下他赤膊骑马、冬泳以及驾驶战斗机的画面。

icy.en: OK then, let’s step into the icy, unsettling world of the Salem Witch Trials.
icy.zh: 好了，让我们走进塞勒姆审巫案那冰冷、令人不安的世界吧。

icy.en: Professor Gunhild Sætren lives on the icy island of Svalbard, 800 miles inside the Arctic Circle.
icy.zh: Gunhild Sætren 教授住在冰天雪地的斯瓦尔巴群岛，这里位于北极圈内800英里处。

icy.en: To the 500 or so Puritans huddled in their icy wooden homes, he was an ever-present enemy, lurking in the shadows, waiting to snatch their souls.
icy.zh: 对于挤在冰冷木屋里的那大约500名清教徒来说，他是无处不在的敌人，潜伏在阴影中，随时准备夺走他们的灵魂。

icy.en: Given the cost of getting to an asteroid, any mission needs to be fairly sure that it will find what it’s looking for, and given that not all asteroids are created equal–some are rocky, others are icy, and others contain high levels of precious metals–you need to send a fact-finding mission first before committing to a mining mission.
icy.zh: 考虑到前往小行星的高昂成本，任何任务都需要有相当大的把握确保能找到所寻找的东西，而且鉴于并非所有小行星生来平等——有些是岩石质的，有些是冰质的，还有些含有高含量的贵金属——在承诺进行采矿任务之前，你需要先派出一趟事实勘察任务。
